GRADE 10 CSL PROJECT SCORING GUIDE (100 MARKS)
THEME: BUILDING INCLUSIVITY AND SOCIAL COHESION IN OUR COMMUNITY
TASK 1: PREPARATION STAGE – 40 MARKS
Step 1: Group Leadership & Understanding the Task (5 marks)
(Evidence of the group meeting sessions and responses for step 1.)
Criteria Score
Identification of group leadership positions. 2
List of leaders and their respective roles assigned. 2
Evidence of brainstorming and efforts towards comprehending the project guidelines
(brainstorming notes, consultations).
 Sub Total 5
Step 2: Identification and Definition of School Community Problem (10 marks)
(Evidence of the group meeting sessions and the three responses for step 2.)
Criteria Score
Evidence of several gaps generated from a brainstorming exercise (a list of more than
two authentic gaps in line with the theme from the group work)
One problem selected with relevant justification 3
Written down 2-3 paragraphs describing the problem identified 4
 Sub Total 10
Step 3: Design of Intervention / Solution (15 marks)
(Evidence that the meeting sessions were conducted and the corresponding responses for
Step 3.)
Criteria Score
Solution clearly addresses the identified problem (check relevance) 3
Solution is realistic, ethical and appropriate to the school context 2
Clear identification of beneficiaries (list of beneficiaries) 2
Criteria Score
Clear description of location, resources and approach (use of locally available
resources)
Well-written project title that is aligned with the theme 2
Evidence of consultation/validation with relevant stakeholders 2
Solution clearly links to previous class work (subject and strand) 1
 Sub Total 15
Step 4: Project Planning & Organisation (10 marks)
(Evidence that the meeting sessions were conducted, the corresponding Step 4 responses, and
an implementation matrix)
Criteria Score
Clear activity plan with a logical sequence of tasks 3
Identification of relevant stakeholders and their role in the project 1
Identification of appropriate materials/resources 2
Realistic milestones(stages) and timelines proposed 2
Clear rules promoting respect and safety 1
Responsibility for each group member well defined 1
 Sub Total 10

TASK 2: IMPLEMENTATION STAGE – 25 MARKS
Step 5: Execution of Project Activities (15 marks)
(Observe as learners execute the project activities, review evidence of execution for step 5.)
Criteria Score
Planned activities fully implemented 4
Learners demonstrated cooperation and teamwork 2
Respectful and inclusive behaviour is evident during CSL project implementation 2
Evidence of engagement with the relevant community members 2
Application of classroom learning to execute the CSL project 3
Evidence of reflective sessions conducted (reflection notes) 2
 Sub Total 15
Step 6: Documentation of Project Progress (10 marks)
(Evidence of project implementation and the Step 6 responses.)
Criteria Score
Clear and consistent activity records/notes 3
Evidence collected (photos, sketches, videos, notes) 3
Identification of challenges and successes 3
Completeness check (detailed portfolio available) 1
 Sub Total 10

TASK 3: POST-IMPLEMENTATION STAGE – 35 MARKS
Step 7: Reflection (20 marks)
(Refer to the individual learner reflection notes for scoring.)
 i) Individual Reflection (10 marks)
Criteria Score
Clear description of what the learner learnt, as outlined in the portfolio 2
Clear description of attitude or mindset change (analyse how the learner
articulates/expresses themselves, check creativity)
Identification of values developed (any two) 1
Identification of competencies developed (any two) 1
Detailed and open reflection (check on the examples) 2
Subjects applied in the CSL project 2
 Sub Total 10
 ii) Group Reflection (10 marks)
(Refer to the group reflection or discussion notes for scoring.)
Criteria Score
Clear analysis of what worked well 3
Discussion of challenges faced 3
Realistic suggestions for addressing future challenges 2
Explanation of project benefits to individuals and the school community 2
 Sub Total 10
Step 8: Report Writing and Presentation of Project (15 marks)
(Observes and receive responses based on Step 6 for scoring)
Criteria Score
The report clearly presents all the aspects as outlined 6
Good creativity and clarity of presentation 3
Group participation and communication skills 4
Quality of recommendations for the future 2
 Sub Total 15
